title: Audit 16 sensor logs, each with its own correction
goal: Follow TASK.md: audit all 16 sensor logs in data/, applying each file's own correction from its note, and produce answers.json covering every file. A hidden grader checks every field. The workspace that holds the final, complete answers.json is the one that counts, so make sure one worker integrates all results into a single answers.json.
rubric: Every file's note is different and written in prose; read each one. Exactness matters: rounding and the definitions in TASK.md are the specification. Split the files across workers if useful, but the final answers.json must cover all 16 files.
